name: Pile Up
summary: Bulk delete for a file list: picked rows fly into a pile, get squashed and drop into the bin
about: Pile Up is a bulk delete for lists. Tick a few files and a dark action bar springs up with the count and total size. Press Delete and each picked row lifts, flies up and lands on a wobbly pile above the button; the pile is squashed into one brick, the bin opens like a hatch and swallows it with a puff of dust. Storage frees up live, and Undo pops every file back into its own row.
how: Tick files (or Select all); the action bar slides up with the count and size.
Press Delete (or the Del key): the rows lift, fly up and stack into a pile above the button.
The pile is squashed into a brick, the bin lid opens and the brick drops in with a puff.
The storage meter drops and the bar says how much was freed; press Undo within 5 seconds to bring every file back.
Esc clears the picks; Clear does the same.
